fullPassage:
Hello, my awesome classmates!
Since last week, our school has introduced a Food Diary Project. Our slogan? "Low sugar, low salt, and low fat." Do you want to join this project? Follow these steps. Choose healthy foods for your meals, take photos, and share them with us. Don't forget to leave friendly comments on your friends' posts.
Ready to join? Have fun sharing!
After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea instead. It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot healthier with the tea.
This afternoon, my friends and I had malatang. I thought it was a good choice because it had meat, vegetables, and noodles. But when I got home, I felt really thirsty. I drank a lot of water, but it didn't help. I think malatang was too salty for me. I've decided to eat less salty foods from now on.
On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack. The potato chips at the convenience store looked delicious. But I've learned that they have a lot of unhealthy fats. So, I chose nuts instead. Nuts are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. They're much better than chips for the body.

questions.passage:
After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink.

(A) It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot healthier with the tea.
(B) But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar.
(C) So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea instead.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 축구 경기 후 탄산음료를 마시고 싶었다 → (B) 성분을 확인하니 설탕 10티스푼 → (C) 허브차를 선택하기로 결정 → (A) 허브차는 설탕이 적고 더 건강하게 느낌
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): 성분 확인 → 허브차 선택 → 결과(건강하게 느낌)
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 결과부터 나옴 — 비논리적
❌ ② (A)-(C)-(B): 결과 → 선택 → 확인 순서 역전
❌ ④ (C)-(A)-(B): 선택이 확인보다 먼저

questions.passage:
On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack.

(A) So, I chose nuts instead. Nuts are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals.
(B) The potato chips at the convenience store looked delicious.
(C) But I've learned that they have a lot of unhealthy fats.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 배가 고파서 간식을 원했다 → (B) 감자칩이 맛있어 보였다 → (C) 하지만 건강에 좋지 않은 지방이 많다는 것을 알게 됨 → (A) 대신 견과류를 선택
det.analysis:
✅ ② (B)-(C)-(A): 감자칩 → 건강 문제 인식 → 견과류 선택
❌ ① (A)-(C)-(B): 선택이 먼저 나옴
❌ ③ (C)-(A)-(B): But이 첫 문장에 올 수 없음
❌ ④ (C)-(B)-(A): But이 첫 문장에 올 수 없음

det.korean: 물을 많이 마셔도 소용없었다(③) → 마라탕이 너무 짰다고 생각(삽입) → 덜 짠 음식을 먹기로 결심(④)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ (③과 ④ 사이): 물을 마셔도 소용없었다 → 원인 분석(너무 짜서) → 결심
❌ ① 처음에 원인이 올 수 없음
❌ ② 집에 오기 전에 짠맛 판단 불가
❌ ③ 물 마시기 전에 원인 분석 부자연스러움

questions.passage: Hello, my awesome classmates! Since last week, our school has introduced a Food Diary Project. Do you want to join this project? Follow these steps. Choose healthy foods for your ①<u>meals</u>, take photos, and share ②<u>them</u> with us. Don't forget ③<u>leaving</u> friendly comments on your friends' ④<u>posts</u>.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ leaving → to leave: 'forget + to부정사'는 '~할 것을 잊다'라는 의미. 'forget + -ing'는 '~한 것을 잊다'로 문맥에 맞지 않음.
det.analysis:
✅ ① meals: 복수 명사 적절
✅ ② them: photos를 받는 복수 대명사 적절
❌ ③ leaving: forget to leave가 맞음 (앞으로 해야 할 일)
✅ ④ posts: 복수 명사 적절
det.tip: Don't forget to + 동사원형 (앞으로 할 일을 잊지 마)

questions.passage: On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack. The potato chips at the convenience store looked ①<u>deliciously</u>. But I've learned that they have a lot of ②<u>unhealthy</u> fats. So, I chose nuts ③<u>instead</u>. Nuts are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and ④<u>minerals</u>.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① deliciously → delicious: look은 감각동사이므로 보어로 형용사(delicious)가 와야 한다. 부사(deliciously)는 틀림.
det.analysis:
❌ ① deliciously: look + 형용사(보어). looked delicious가 맞음
✅ ② unhealthy: 형용사로 fats를 수식 적절
✅ ③ instead: 부사로 '대신에' 적절
✅ ④ minerals: 복수 명사 적절

questions.passage: After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea __________. It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot healthier with the tea.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 탄산음료 대신에 허브차를 선택했다. instead = 대신에
det.analysis:
✅ ③ instead: '대신에' — 탄산음료 대신 허브차
❌ ① together: '함께' — 문맥 부적합
❌ ② also: '또한' — 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ finally: '마침내' — 문맥 부적합

questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 목이 말라서 '물'을 많이 마셨다는 문맥. water = 물
det.analysis:
✅ ② water: 목이 마르면 물을 마시는 것이 자연스러움
❌ ① juice: 쥬스 — 가능하지만 원문은 water
❌ ③ milk: 우유 — 목마를 때 부자연스러움
❌ ④ coffee: 커피 — 목마를 때 부자연스러움

questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② healthy → unhealthy: 감자칩의 지방은 '건강에 좋지 않은(unhealthy)' 지방이다. healthy(건강한)는 문맥에 맞지 않음.
det.analysis:
✅ ① delicious: 감자칩이 맛있어 보였다 — 적절
❌ ② healthy: 감자칩의 지방을 '건강한'이라고 하면 뒤에서 견과류를 선택하는 이유가 없음 → unhealthy가 맞음
✅ ③ instead: '대신에' — 적절
✅ ④ minerals: '무기질' — 적절
det.tip: ② healthy → unhealthy: chips에는 unhealthy fats
